cases.title: After the first drawing was closed without saving and a fresh copy reopened in the same AutoCAD, a downpipe still places (BUG-1225)
cases.plan_item: BUG-1225 control (switch OFF: the refusal must come back)
cases.expected: On the reopened copy, DP at 150000,-80000 prints 'Downpipe placed. Tag: DP<n>.' and offers the next DP; one new DOWNPIPE DYNAMIC WITH MASK insert exists; no 'could not be refreshed' and no 'Nothing will be placed here' in the history.
cases.why_not_unit: The refusal comes from the live drawing's landing index after a real close and reopen in the same AutoCAD.
not_automated: Whether a drafter's own close-without-save and reopen behaves the same as the runner's reopen-copy is not established by this case.
